trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Work through stages 1 to 4 of the roadmap in this guide.
Keep cheats off the whole run: they disable trophies and saving.
The platinum pops on its own when the other 54 are earned.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: roadmap totals: 4/10 difficulty, about 200 hours, one playthrough, cheats disable trophies

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: the official list: 55 trophies, 1 platinum, no online or DLC trophies

trophies.guide: The platinum is the capstone: it unlocks by itself once the other 54 trophies are in. Everything on the list is single-player, one playthrough is enough, and there are no difficulty settings to pick (PowerPyx) (GTABase). Budget roughly 200 hours, most of it inside the 100 percent checklist (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start the story and play the opening missions of Chapter 1.
Finish Gone Fishing, one of the first main missions.
The trophy pops automatically at the end of the mission.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: Gone Fishing is the first main mission of Chapter 1 and the trophy cannot be missed

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; a Chapter 1 story trophy that can't be missed

trophies.guide: A story trophy for Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically as you finish the mission and cannot be missed (PowerPyx) (GTABase). It is hidden on PSN until earned, so it stays masked here while spoilers are on.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1.
Start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
The Chapter 1 trophy is awarded as the new chapter begins.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 2; automatic and unmissable

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; pops once the first Chapter 2 mission is played

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 and this lands as soon as you play the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? (GTABase). Like every chapter trophy it is automatic story progress, so there is nothing special to set up (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2.
Begin Chapter 3 with Welcome to Vice City.
The Chapter 2 trophy pops as the new chapter opens.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 3; automatic and unmissable

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; awarded as Chapter 3 begins

trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 completion trophy, awarded as Chapter 3 begins after Welcome to Vice City (GTABase). The asterisks are part of the official name exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Automatic and unmissable (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3.
Play the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
The Chapter 3 trophy pops after those opening missions.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4; automatic and unmissable

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; arrives after Ocean Beach and Another Life

trophies.guide: Chapter 3's completion trophy arrives a little late: it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life (PowerPyx) (GTABase). Nothing to prepare, just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4.
Finish the chapter's final main mission.
The trophy pops automatically at the chapter's end.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: automatic story trophy for completing Chapter 4; cannot be missed

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; Chapter 4 completion, can't be missed

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and the trophy follows automatically (PowerPyx). It is one of the 28 trophies hidden on PSN until earned (GTABase), so expect it to be masked in your console list while you play.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play the story through all five chapters.
Complete the final mission.
Keep playing afterwards: free roam continues for the cleanup stages.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the only hidden gold; automatic at the final mission; free roam continues after the story

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; no trophy depends on how a mission is played; no mission replay

trophies.guide: The story's finishing line and the only gold hidden on PSN: complete the final mission (GTABase). Free roam carries on after the credits, so finishing the story locks nothing away; every cleanup trophy stays available (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach Chapter 2 in the story.
Play the main mission Breakfast Run.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 main mission; automatic and unmissable

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; Chapter 2 story mission

trophies.guide: A named-mission story trophy: finish Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 (PowerPyx). It unlocks during normal story progress and cannot be missed (GTABase).

trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach Chapter 3 in the story.
Play the main mission The Cartel Heist.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 main mission; automatic and unmissable

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; story-related Chapter 3 mission, can't be missed

trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, a main mission in Chapter 3 (PowerPyx). Story-related and impossible to miss as long as you finish the campaign (GTABase).

trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach Chapter 4 in the story.
Play the main mission Child's Play.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: Child's Play is a Chapter 4 main mission; automatic and unmissable

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; story-related Chapter 4 mission, can't be missed

trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play in Chapter 4 (PowerPyx). A hidden story trophy that arrives on its own as the campaign moves forward (GTABase).

trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach Chapter 4 in the story.
Play the main mission Headliners.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: Headliners is a Chapter 4 main mission; automatic and unmissable

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; story-related Chapter 4 mission, can't be missed

trophies.guide: Finish Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission (PowerPyx). Hidden on PSN and unmissable in a normal story run (GTABase).

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach Chapter 4 in the story.
Play the main mission VCIA Takedown.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 main mission; automatic and unmissable

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; story-related Chapter 4 mission, can't be missed

trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4 (PowerPyx). Not to be confused with the free-roam airport trophy Catch Me If You Can, which is a separate, self-made departure at the same airport.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach Chapter 5, the final chapter.
Play the main mission Operation Savage Glory.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 main mission; automatic and unmissable

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; story-related Chapter 5 mission, can't be missed

trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5, the last of the named-mission story trophies before the finale (PowerPyx) (GTABase).

trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story to reveal the checklist under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion.
Complete in full: all robberies including 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, all 42 Shooting Range golds, all 42 drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks.
Reach the partial quotas: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans.

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: the full and partial 100 percent requirements, and that nothing on the checklist is missable

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: hardest trophy on the list; the checklist is closer to 60 percent true completion

sources.title: GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide
sources.supports: the full 100% checklist this trophy completes, requirement by requirement

trophies.guide: The long gold. The checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the story, but everything you did earlier already counts and nothing on it can be missed (GTABase). It is demanding in full for robberies, vaults, gang operations, range golds, drone races and Target Decks, yet only asks for a share of scans, animals, meditations, challenges and stunts, which is why it lands nearer 60 percent true completion (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Mix the four stunt families freely: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Fly under bridges first; they are the quickest to bank in bulk.
Track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and keep going to 300 for the 100 percent checklist.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: 397 stunts in four categories; under the bridges are quickest; 300 needed for 100 percent

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: any 250 of the 397 stunts count, in any mix

sources.title: GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide
sources.supports: stunt totals on the 100% checklist (300 of 397 there; the trophy itself asks 250)

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the game's 397 stunts count, mixed however you like across stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps (GTABase). Bridge flights are the fastest filler (PowerPyx), and because the 100 percent checklist wants 300, treat 250 as a waypoint rather than the finish.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
steps: Sample all nine types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, winning a race, and performing a stunt.
Check what is missing under Progress, then Activities.
Most types are introduced by the story itself, so sweep this up early.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the tracker counts 9 activity types, visible under Progress, Activities

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: the nine activity types, including sinking one basket and winning any race type

trophies.guide: One taste of everything: the tracker counts nine activity types, from fishing and golf to sinking a single basket and winning any kind of race (GTABase). The story introduces most of them, so this usually completes itself while you work on other trophies (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
steps: Visit all 12 shooting ranges across Leonida.
Earn gold in every challenge at each range, 42 golds in total.
Use the practice: range work also raises your Focus level for Gunslinger.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: 42 gold medals across the shooting ranges, all required in full for 100 percent

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: 42 golds across 12 ranges; ranges raise Focus

sources.title: GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide
sources.supports: 42 of 42 shooting range gold medals required in full

trophies.guide: Gold in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds spread over 12 ranges (GTABase). There is no partial credit from the 100 percent checklist either, which wants all of them (PowerPyx), so learn each range's pattern instead of hoping to skip the awkward ones.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win one race at each location for the trophy.
Stay for the rest: 42 drone races in total are needed for 100 percent.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: 14 Top Fun drone race locations and 42 drone races overall

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: one win per location for the trophy; all 42 races for 100 percent

sources.title: GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide
sources.supports: drone races required in full on the 100% checklist (42 races at 14 locations)

trophies.guide: One win at each of the 14 drone race locations earns the trophy (GTABase). Since the 100 percent checklist asks for all 42 races anyway (PowerPyx), finishing each location while you are there is the efficient route.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Pick from the 40 unique races across the map.
Win 20 different ones; repeating a race does not add to the count.
Bring a suitable vehicle for each race class instead of forcing one car everywhere.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: 40 unique race locations to choose from

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: 20 different race wins; winning the same race twice doesn't count

trophies.guide: Variety is the requirement: 20 different race wins out of the 40 on offer, and repeats do not count (GTABase). Work across the map rather than farming one easy circuit (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
steps: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
Wait for his text, which marks a fishing spot with a purple icon.
Follow his fishing questline through to the challenge and beat him.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: Cal texts after Feng Shui in Chapter 1 and marks a fishing location; follow his questline

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: meet Cal in Feng Shui, then play through his fishing quests to the challenge

trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts you and pins a fishing spot with a purple map icon (PowerPyx). Play through his short fishing questline and the trophy is for beating him in his own challenge at the end of it (GTABase).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Pick one of the four arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are on the TV at home; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade cabinets.
The home TV games can be played from Chapter 1.
Finish every level of your chosen game once; challenges inside it are not required.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the four video games, their locations, and that completing means finishing all levels once

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: reach the end of any one arcade game

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one of the four arcade games. Three sit on the TV at home and can be played during Chapter 1; the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, lives on arcade cabinets around Leonida (PowerPyx). Completing means finishing all of a game's levels once, not beating its side challenges (GTABase).

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3; Andy's questline is exclusive to her and starts with his call and a texted address in Belville.
Work through his five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
The final quest awards the trophy; the line stays available after the story.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: Andy's line is Lucia-only, marked in Chapter 3 in Belville, five quests, available after the story

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; the five Andy quests in order, last one awards the trophy

trophies.guide: Andy's questline belongs to Lucia alone: it opens in Chapter 3 when he calls her and texts a home address in Belville (PowerPyx). Finish his five quests in order and the last one, Puff Puff Pass, hands over the trophy (GTABase). It waits for you after the story if you would rather batch it.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
steps: Start Kenton's line in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams; he is the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive his purple chest markers and dig up treasure with the metal detector at 7 shipwrecks.
Expect a pause: he vanishes after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again in Chapter 2 or 3 to finish the line.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: Kenton in Key Lento, 7 shipwrecks, temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and back later; not missable

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; track progress under Kenton's Treasures in the Progress menu

trophies.guide: Kenton Rees hires you in Chapter 1 to strip 7 shipwrecks, diving purple chest markers and digging with the metal detector (PowerPyx). Do not panic when he disappears after Chapter 1: he returns later in the story, so the line is delayed, never missable (GTABase).

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break to unlock Billy's marker at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Run his five jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
The fifth job awards the trophy; all of them remain available after the story.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: Billy's line opens after Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub; five named jobs; available after the story

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; the fifth job, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy

trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs open at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County once the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break is done (PowerPyx). The last of them, Hometown Heroes, carries the trophy (GTABase), and the whole line survives into post-story free roam.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
steps: Prioritise the strands confirmed to count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Do not count on the character questlines: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count as strangers.
Watch the counter in your trophy list; more qualifying strands are still being confirmed.

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: which strands count (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete) and which do not

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the confirmed strands' quest names; strangers remain findable after the story

trophies.guide: Not every side quest is a stranger strand. The confirmed qualifying lines are Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, while the named character questlines (Andy, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and friends) feed their own trophies instead (GTABase) (PowerPyx). Finish any 8 qualifying strands; the in-game trophy tracker shows your running count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
steps: Unlock the line in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you deliver the Zorrusso to Randy.
Work his Wish List of 16 sports cars, tracked under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List.
Deliver cars in good condition for better pay; his green RK marker sits in the west of Vice City.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: Randy's Wish List of 16 cars, the Key Cloner unlock, and where to find the cars

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; completing Randy's final mission earns the trophy

trophies.guide: Randy's line starts inside the Chapter 3 story mission that hands you the Key Cloner, then becomes a shopping list: 16 named sports cars to steal and deliver, with the list tracked on the map under Robberies (PowerPyx). Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach to spot wishlist models quickly.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
steps: Play as Jason; Tyrone's line opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in purple across Vice City (Take Out Kitty Litter).
Finish his follow-up quest, Spin On This, to shut down the labs and earn the trophy.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: Tyrone's line is Jason-only, opens after Here, Kitty Kitty, labs first then the Spin On This quest

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; completing Tyrone's final mission earns the trophy

trophies.guide: A Jason-only line that opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: wreck Tyrone's rival Synthetic Labs around Vice City, then take his second quest, also called Spin On This, to close the operation down (PowerPyx). Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house (balcony with Lucia, after Down to Earth) becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. Whether the trophy requires it is not yet confirmed; PowerPyx earned the trophy having done it.
steps: After Down to Earth in Chapter 1, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and meditate. Do it before Chapter 1 ends.
Sweep the nine open-world spots: Smooth Sand (Mariana), Swamp, Worn Stone, Red Rocks (Kelly), Water Wheel, Jutting Cliff, Waterfall (Lummox), Seaside (Leonard).
Meditate as both characters at each spot for +2; the last spot, Ascent Mountain (Mount Kalaga), appears only after all others.

sources.title: GTA 6 All Meditation Spot Locations
sources.supports: all 18 meditation spots, the Chapter 1 spot and its warning

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the missable flag; 15 of 18 meditations suffice for 100%

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: 18 spots in 10 locations; the possibly missable flag

trophies.guide: There are 18 meditations in 10 locations, most doable as both characters for double credit (PowerPyx meditation guide). The exception is the first: a balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house in Chapter 1 that vanishes when the chapter ends. Whether the trophy truly needs it is unconfirmed — but it costs two minutes, so do it before leaving Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
steps: Play as Jason after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; Bret Vogel's text starts his line in Lummox County.
Meet Bret (Veteran Hunted) and take his hunting requests from the purple map markers.
Bring him the unique animal he asks for; his 15 Target Decks are also required in full for 100 percent.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: Bret's Jason-only line, the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle, 15 Target Decks, and that the exact animal is still unconfirmed

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only

trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line is Jason-only: his text arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and starts in Lummox County (PowerPyx). Work his requests with the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle he gives you; which single animal counts as the unique one is not yet confirmed (PowerPyx), so simply finish his requests in order.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards toward any of the 18 sets.
Finish three complete sets; partial sets do not count.
Prioritise the sets you are already closest to completing.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: 18 collectible card set locations to work from

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: complete 3 sets out of the 18

trophies.guide: Finish any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets (GTABase). Because only completed sets count, chase the sets your exploring has already nearly finished instead of starting fresh ones (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Hold up on the D-pad, then R1, to scan with the WAiNK app.
Scan any mix: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags.
Keep scanning past 100 only if you are chasing vehicle scans for other trophies too.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the scan input, the category counts, and that any 100 scans count

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: WAiNK scans at 100 locations across the four categories

sources.title: GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide
sources.supports: 100 WAiNK locations scanned on the 100% checklist

trophies.guide: Point the WAiNK app at 100 scannable sights: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags all feed the same counter, and there are more than 100 in the world (PowerPyx). It doubles as a habit worth building early, because the same app scans vehicles for Whip It Good and A Long Road.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Browse the 80 challenges under Progress, then Challenges.
Bank the easy ones you complete naturally while doing other trophies.
Finish at 50 here, then push to 70 of 80 for the 100 percent checklist.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: 80 challenges exist; 70 of 80 are needed for 100 percent, so this trophy comes automatically

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: complete 50 of the 80 challenges

sources.title: GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide
sources.supports: challenge quota on the 100% checklist (70 of 80 there; the trophy itself asks 50)

trophies.guide: Fifty of the game's 80 challenges, tracked under Progress, Challenges (PowerPyx). Save it for late in the run: by then most will already be ticked from ordinary play, and the 100 percent checklist will push you on to 70 anyway (GTABase).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
steps: Wait until the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break unlocks free-roaming together; call your partner with hold right on the D-pad plus Triangle.
Cause enough trouble to reach a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and leave the red heat zone; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: earliest after Coffee Break, the partner call input, and the train tunnel escape route

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat

trophies.guide: A co-op escape: with both characters free-roaming together after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, raise a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely, driving out of the red heat zone rather than just the flashing search area (PowerPyx). If you skip it, the Chapter 4 bank vault work triggers 4-star escapes anyway and hands it to you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner and gear up: armored vest, sticky bombs, healing items.
Rob three shops in a row while keeping the flashing wanted level alive the whole time.
The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) unlocks them; expect the trophy to pop about 30 seconds late.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the method: keep the flashing wanted level, the north Vice City jewelry stores, and the delayed unlock

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing the wanted level

trophies.guide: Three robberies, one unbroken police chase, both characters together. The trap is escaping too well between shops: the flashing wanted level must never fully drop (PowerPyx). Loot a couple of items per store, and do not worry if the trophy lands half a minute after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open the WAiNK app with hold up on the D-pad and scan vehicles with R1; scanning is enough, no driving needed.
Stand on a busy road and scan traffic, including boats and aircraft when you see them.
Check totals under Progress, then Vehicles; 200 of 277 base models are needed for 100 percent.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: 557 vehicles at launch, the scanning method, and the 200 of 277 figure for 100 percent

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: discover 100 vehicles by scanning them

trophies.guide: Discover, not drive: hold up for the WAiNK app and scan passing vehicles with R1 until 100 different ones are logged (PowerPyx). Start the habit in Chapter 1 and this finishes itself long before the 200 scans the 100 percent checklist demands.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
steps: Raise your Focus first: food and drink, a shower, and Adrenaline to stretch the effect.
Line up five criminals at a gang operation, wearing body armor, with an assault rifle such as the Duke 556.
Trigger Combat Focus with L3 plus R3 while aiming and drop all five before it ends; it does not work on soldiers, police or civilians.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the Combat Focus input, focus buffs, the Duke 556 advice, and which targets do not count

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: fill Focus first and use an assault rifle; ranges raise Focus level

trophies.guide: Five takedowns inside one Combat Focus window, which only lasts a few seconds. Preparation is the whole trick: max the purple Focus bar, line up five gang members at an operation, and use a full-auto assault rifle (PowerPyx) (GTABase). It gets easier at Focus level 4, which range work and headshots build over time.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
steps: Go to VCIA and pick a passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge, easiest at terminals E3 and E4; planes parked on the open airfield do not count.
Enter by the stairs beside the bridge, go up to the cockpit and taxi out backwards.
Take off and fly about 1 kilometre away; the trophy unlock is slightly delayed.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the docked-jet requirement, terminals E3/E4, and the 1 km distance

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; steal a passenger jet at a boarding gate and get about 1 km away

trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet that is docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA (the E3/E4 plane is the easy one), taxi it out and take off (PowerPyx). Keep flying: the trophy pops once you are roughly a kilometre from the airport (GTABase).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Head to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County.
The tanks stand in the south of the base; enter through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Climb in and shoot enemies from inside the tank until it pops.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: tank location at Mile Zero Air Station and how to get in

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside

trophies.guide: The cryptic description means exactly what it hints: steal a Rhino tank. They are parked in the south of Mile Zero Air Station on the south-west island in Mariana County (PowerPyx). Get in, shoot some enemies, done (GTABase).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies.
Pick a store, for example Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City, and enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it.
Find the safe code note in the back room, empty the safe and leave unseen.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the Snap Gun unlock, the back-door method, the safe code note, and a named store

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give the Snap Gun for the back door

trophies.guide: A quiet robbery: Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs hand you the Snap Gun, which opens alarmed back doors silently (GTABase). Slip in the back, read the note with the safe code, loot the safe and leave before anyone knows (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Unlock vault robberies in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, tailing the security van to its bank.
Buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 once his earlier quests are done; follow the purple icon and enter while the vault is open.
Every vault brings an instant 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and swap vehicles; any 5 of the 8 vaults count.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the unlock mission, Yasmani's tips, the 4-star escape, 8 vaults total and up to $205,000 per bank

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: rob 5 of the 8 vaults; vaults open with an optional Chapter 4 mission

trophies.guide: The endgame earner: tail security vans, slip into the vault while it is open, and escape the automatic 4 stars (PowerPyx). Five of the eight vaults earn the trophy, all eight are needed for 100 percent, and at up to $205,000 a bank this also funds the money trophies (GTABase).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
steps: Easiest path: the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is robs a vault from a tailed truck, which counts automatically.
Earlier alternative: block a roaming armored truck near a bank and blow its back door with a sticky bomb.
Either way, the trophy only lands after you escape the red heat radius.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the automatic unlock in the Chapter 4 optional mission and the sticky bomb alternative

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: rob an armored truck and escape; a bank vault job counts if you get away

trophies.guide: Most players get this for free during the Chapter 4 optional mission that unlocks bank vaults, because robbing the vault from the tailed truck counts as robbing the truck (GTABase). Impatient players can sticky-bomb a roaming truck's rear doors instead, then escape the heat (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Take a plane and fly over every patch of black fog left on the map.
Work region by region so no inland pocket stays hidden.
The trophy lands when the whole map is visible.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: fully unfog the map; a plane is the best tool

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: clear the fog from the whole map; flying is fastest

trophies.guide: Pure cartography: clear the fog from the entire map of Leonida (GTABase). A plane makes short work of it; sweep the black patches methodically rather than wandering (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
steps: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs; they show as yellow map icons when you come near.
Track per-gang progress under Progress, then Gangs.
All 39 operations are required for 100 percent, so this completes along the way.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: 9 gangs, 39 operations, yellow icons, and progress tracking under Progress, Gangs

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: one operation per gang, 9 gangs; all 39 for 100 percent

trophies.guide: Spread the damage evenly: one robbed operation for each of the nine gangs (GTABase). Operations appear as yellow icons as you explore, and because the 100 percent checklist wants all 39 anyway, this is a progress trophy rather than a project (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
steps: Honest status: the exact trigger is not yet confirmed by any source we trust.
The description points at having a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach; try beachfront bars there.
This page will not guess: check back as the launch guides pin it down.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: this trophy is currently listed as unknown

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; exact trigger unconfirmed

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown and no launch guide has pinned the trigger down (PowerPyx) (GTA Zone). The description suggests a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but we label that as the description talking, not as a method.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
steps: First get the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee inside.
Drive it straight out through the showroom window; the trophy pops a little after you reach the street.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the specific blue Banshee, the south Vice City showroom, the Key Cloner requirement, and the GTA III nod

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; driving out through the showroom window

trophies.guide: A deliberate throwback: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it out through the glass, exactly like the old GTA III opening (PowerPyx). Only that specific car works, and you need the Key Cloner from Chapter 3 before it will start for you.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
steps: Take the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, bringing sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation.
Steal all three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it open).
Escape the police afterwards; the trophy unlocks once you are clear, and missed items can be collected when the robbery respawns.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the three key valuables and their spots, the sticky bombs, and that the trophy is not missable

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police

trophies.guide: Not bowling at all: it is the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, offered as the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling (PowerPyx). Take all three golden-icon valuables, blow the office safe with sticky bombs, and the trophy lands once you have lost the police (GTABase).

trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when both characters can be called together.
Buy a fitness club membership and always work out as a pair: call your partner with hold right plus Triangle.
While you train one character the other trains automatically, so max Strength for both at the same time.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: maximum Strength for both characters, the paired workout method, and where to check the stat

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia

trophies.guide: The 'mass appeal' is muscle: maximum Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time (GTABase). Work out together at a fitness club; while you train one of them the partner trains automatically, so both bars climb in parallel (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings, UI, HUD Notifications.
Accumulate 500 profile-changing actions; robberies and enemy encounters all count passively.
Keep it clean where you can: the Irredeemable profile is permanent, so avoid endless cop-killing sprees.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: 500 actions, the five profile levels, the notification setting, and the permanent Irredeemable warning

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile

trophies.guide: Your reputation, counted: 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile, from stealthy Professional play to the permanent Irredeemable status at the violent end (PowerPyx). It accrues passively through robberies and fights, so most players earn it without trying; just do not live at the violent end, because Irredeemable never washes off.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Honest status: the exact trigger is not yet confirmed.
PowerPyx's current belief is that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue; treat that as a lead, not a method.
If a first attempt at something fails, try it again; the description hints at a second try succeeding.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: currently unknown; believed related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; one of the five unconfirmed entries

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists it as unknown, with a working theory tying it to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue (PowerPyx). Until a source verifies the trigger, this guide labels it honestly instead of dressing a guess up as steps (GTA Zone).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Honest status: the exact trigger is not yet confirmed.
PowerPyx's current belief is that it belongs to a UFO questline; watch for strange-sky events as you explore.
When a verified method appears in the launch guides, follow it here rather than forum rumours.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: currently unknown; believed to be from a UFO questline

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; one of the five unconfirmed entries

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. The description and PowerPyx's working theory both point at something strange in the sky, most likely a UFO questline (PowerPyx). We list it as unconfirmed rather than inventing a ritual (GTA Zone).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
steps: Honest status: the exact trigger is not yet confirmed.
PowerPyx's current belief is kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle; that is testable on any ride.
Try melee attacks from a bike against enemies and see whether the counter moves.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: currently unknown; believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
sources.supports: hidden on PSN; one of the five unconfirmed entries

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed, but the description is nearly a recipe: a melee drive-by that bowls someone over. PowerPyx's current belief is a kick from a moving motorcycle (PowerPyx); until it is verified, treat that as the leading theory, not a guarantee (GTA Zone).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then deliver the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
It is a running total across all robberies, and one bank vault can hold up to $205,000 of it.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the Credit Check unlock, the running total, and Yasmani paying the most

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts; a running total

trophies.guide: Dirty money, cleaned in instalments: after Chapter 3's Credit Check mission gives you the Dye Pack Jammer, fence the marked bills from your robberies until $250,000 has been laundered in total (PowerPyx). Yasmani pays the best rate, and the bank vaults from stage 3 make this quick (GTABase).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend across any shops; the total is cumulative, not per store.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest sinks for cash.
Robbery income from stages 3 and 4 makes this a formality late in the run.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the $100,000 total across all shops and the fastest spending categories

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: spend $100,000 across all shops as a running total

trophies.guide: The pleasant one: spend $100,000 in total across Leonida's shops, any mix you like (GTABase). Weapons, car modifications and tattoos burn money fastest (PowerPyx), and by the cleanup stage your robbery income covers it without thinking.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app for about $160,000 in total.
The 4 story garages do not count, and the parking space unlocks On the Spot.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: 8 purchasable garages at $160,000 total, the real estate app unlock, and the 4 story garages being excluded

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: purchase all 8 garages for sale, about $160,000 in total

trophies.guide: Buy the eight garages that are actually for sale, roughly $160,000 all in, through the Vice City Real Estate app that arrives after Chapter 2's Daily Driver (PowerPyx). The four story garages are free and do not count (GTABase); the bought space is what On the Spot needs.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
steps: The Scooter Bros app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission for Moses; buy garages first so you have parking space.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register, at his garage.
Register cheap cars and bikes to keep costs down; from Chapter 3, tracker cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.supports: the app unlock, Moses in Port Gellhorn, the garage space requirement, and the cheap vehicle tip

sources.title: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)
sources.supports: register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app Moses gives you in Chapter 2

trophies.guide: Make stolen cars yours: register ten of them in the Scooter Bros app that Moses installs in Chapter 2 (GTABase). Each registration needs garage space and a fee, so buy the Little Boxes garages first and register cheap cars and bikes at Moses' Port Gellhorn garage (PowerPyx).
